notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only evidence is two lookout lists (FFLA and a Virginia forest lookouts list) with name, county, coordinates and a gone status. Two web searches and no hits on the tower itself; no build, staffing, or fate detail. The story is about 80 words, under the roughly 120-word guide target, because padding was judged worse than a short honest story. Brief record (status gone, county Orange, coordinates) matches FFLA.
